def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 167, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length)
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  coverage_points = []

  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)

      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

      [parameter_index, value_index]

      next
    end

      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }

    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)

  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: nil, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))

    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)

  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|

      [parameter_index, value_index]

      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: -1, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 167, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 1, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)

      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 167, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: nil, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end

    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(nil, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)

      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(167, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")

  unless engine.can_complete?({})

  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: nil))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min

      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)

      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)

  coverage_points = []

    rows << row

    coverage_points << CoveragePoint

      [parameter_index, value_index]

      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")

    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)

  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")

  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    nil
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|

      next

      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]

    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: nil, scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: nil, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if false
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  rows = []
  coverage_points = []

  limit_reached = false

  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, nil, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

    end

  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|

      limit_reached = true
      break
    end

      [parameter_index, value_index]

    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true

    end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

    rows << row

    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

    end

  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|

      next
    end

      limit_reached = true

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered: nil, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    unless should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  rows = []
  coverage_points = []

  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|

      next
    end

      limit_reached = true

    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, nil, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end

  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while nil && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
